description: The figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating, for several evaluation criteria, the percentage of items that are “Matched” versus “Not Matched.” The category axis is the vertical axis, listing (top to bottom) “No Hallucination,” “Oriented,” “Active,” an unlabeled row (shown with a blank/gray label area), “Rigorous,” and “Correct.” The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled in percentages, using a linear scale from 0% to 100% with tick marks at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%. Each category has a single bar stacked into two segments: a dark blue “Matched” segment followed by a lighter blue “Not Matched” segment, as indicated by the legend. The “No Hallucination” bar shows 98.33% matched and 1.67% not matched; “Oriented” shows 97.33% matched and 2.67% not matched; “Active” shows 97.00% matched and 3.00% not matched; the unlabeled row shows 94.00% matched and 6.00% not matched; “Rigorous” shows 95.33% matched and 4.67% not matched; and “Correct” shows 99.00% matched and 1.00% not matched. The bars appear in the listed order rather than being sorted by value, and each segment is annotated with its percentage value; no additional highlighting beyond the color scheme and labels is shown.
